purpose: normalized order-level source evidence for buyer-grade monthly economics
entry_rules: order_id must resolve to one sent order
amount_rub is a non-negative two-decimal RUB amount; consideration and acquisition cost must be positive
source_record_sha256 is a lowercase SHA-256 digest of immutable source evidence
exactly one customer_consideration component exists per fulfilled order
customer_consideration equals the fulfilled order RUB amount
exactly one crypto_acquisition_cost component exists per fulfilled order
exactly one payment_provider_fee and one network_fee component exist per fulfilled order
zero-value fees must be evidenced explicitly and cannot be inferred from absence

accounting_policy_gate.reason: principal-versus-agent presentation requires an approved accounting policy

reporting_rules: incomplete orders are counted but excluded from economic spread
gross economic spread is customer consideration less acquisition cost fees refunds and chargebacks
gross economic spread is an operational metric and must not be labelled revenue gross profit EBITDA or SDE
monthly output is aggregate only and contains no customer identifiers or source record identifiers
